com.sun.tools.doclets.formats.html

类 PackageIndexWriter

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.tools.doclets.formats.html.markup.HtmlWriter
      • com.sun.tools.doclets.formats.html.markup.HtmlDocWriter
        • com.sun.tools.doclets.formats.html.HtmlDocletWriter
          • com.sun.tools.doclets.formats.html.AbstractPackageIndexWriter
            • com.sun.tools.doclets.formats.html.PackageIndexWriter

  • public class PackageIndexWriter
extends AbstractPackageIndexWriter
    Generate the package index page "overview-summary.html" for the right-hand frame. A click on the package name on this page will update the same frame with the "package-summary.html" file for the clicked package.

    This is NOT part of any supported API. If you write code that depends on this, you do so at your own risk. This code and its internal interfaces are subject to change or deletion without notice.

    作者:
    Atul M Dambalkar, Bhavesh Patel (Modified)
